title: Mission Match Board
one_liner: Paste your prize mission and a list of prospect bios to get a ranked list of who has publicly said they care about your goal.
headline: Paste your mission and a batch of prospect bios to get a ranked sponsor list with the exact sentence proving each match and a ready-to-send outreach draft.

episode.title: Thanksgiving Special: The Moments That Almost Ended Us (And Why We’re Grateful) | EP #316

history.summary: This is a genuinely working tool, not a canned demo: it scores, ranks and highlights evidence from whatever mission and prospect text the visitor pastes, labels template vs. AI drafts correctly, and exports a real CSV — all closely matching the 'Stated-Goal Sponsor Finder' opportunity. The main weakness is the naive keyword/synonym matcher producing false positives on negated statements ('never mentioned refugees'), which is honestly disclosed in both the UI caveat and README but still dents real-world usefulness for the target customer. Figures, labels and footer credit all check out; no honesty or acceptance failures found.
